deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 39 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Revision Level\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 39` output filtered to the `Revision Level` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; extracts a revision string without proving string reference, PSU identity or the revision's component domain.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; separates PSU revision from BIOS/BMC firmware but lowers capability for inputs.

original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 PSU Revision Level against the correct supply/FRU baseline, explicitly separate it from BIOS/BMC firmware versions, and confirm persistence after reboot.
original_method: Resolve each Revision Level string reference, bind its free-form exact value to a stable PSU identity, compare using approved PSU-specific formatting/alias rules and repeat after approved reboot without firmware updates.
manual_activity: A user identifies the authoritative PSU revision source/format and approves reboot; no flashing or physical action is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected PSU revision per stable supply/FRU identity
Explicit separation from BIOS, BMC and PSU firmware-version fields
Type 39 parser, read-only FRU inventory and reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not flash any PSU, BMC or BIOS component to validate this read-only field.
Do not infer numeric ordering from a free-form revision string.
Validate the string index and bind the exact value to the correct PSU.
Stop on power/management loss; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve each Revision Level reference, preserve exact text, label its component domain, compare with approved PSU/FRU evidence and diff across reboot.
Report dangling, blank, wrong-domain, unexpected or drifting revisions without declaring PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve PSU revision source, formatting/aliases and reboot plan.
Resolve acceptable hardware-revision variants and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep omits raw index, supply ownership and can be confused with unrelated firmware revisions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive all raw/decoded Type 39; emit stable PSU identity, string index, exact PSU revision, separated BIOS/BMC versions and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Revision Level scope, script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no firmware change is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate the string reference, preserve the free-form PSU revision, bind it to FRU identity, keep all other firmware versions in separate evidence fields and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Revision Level definition plus approved PSU/FRU revision data.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds component-domain separation, raw reference validation and identity-specific formatting policy.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects valid-looking but wrong-component revisions and avoids invalid numeric-version assumptions.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative PSU revision map and format policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some inventory interfaces expose PSU firmware rather than hardware Revision Level; those values are not interchangeable unless the owner documents the mapping.

project_override_considerations: Projects may accept qualified revision aliases, but cannot replace this field with BIOS/BMC/PSU firmware versions or authorize flashing under this case.
expected_evidence: Approved PSU revision/FRU map and formatting policy
Pre-reboot Type 39 handles, raw indices and exact Revision Level strings
Separated component-version evidence and per-supply FRU comparison
Statement that no firmware or PSU state changed
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Revision Level is a defined Type 39 string; the component-specific baseline is an execution input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String/domain/identity validation is automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds component-domain, raw reference and stable PSU identity validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps the no-flash boundary while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Keeps missing revision mappings in readiness rather than reducing capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a BIOS/BMC firmware value or numerically parsed free-form string from being misreported as the PSU hardware Revision Level.
independent_technical_reasoning: The field is a free-form revision string owned by a particular Type 39 supply record; correctness depends on component identity and an approved FRU baseline, not generic version syntax.
